hero.title: Hi, I'm Tomas Morales
hero.subtitle: I'm building the future of education with Arbor Learning — an AI-powered PreU that turns a diagnostic into a personalized mastery path. 10+ years shipping products, now focused on helping students succeed.

about.title: About Me
about.bio: Education in Chile is broken for too many students. Traditional PreUs deliver the same content to everyone, ignoring each student's unique gaps. I saw this problem firsthand — and after 10 years shipping 50+ products as an engineer and CTO, I decided to fix it. Arbor Learning is a digital PreU powered by AI that diagnoses where each student stands and builds a personalized mastery path. With 10k+ validated questions and 200+ lessons per subject, we're making PAES preparation truly adaptive.

blog.title: Blog
blog.intro: I write about building AI products, education systems, and human performance.

posts.title: AI Won't Steal Our Jobs — It'll Give Us Our Time Back
posts.excerpt: AI is already taking repetitive work off our hands. But something different comes with it—AI makes people incredibly productive. What if we finally reach a point where work stops consuming our whole life?

posts.title: Ship Faster by Knowing When NOT to Use AI
posts.excerpt: The fastest way to real impact with AI isn't a clever prompt — it's knowing where AI excels, where it fails, and where to go deterministic. Use strong exemplars, a stable spec, and ruthless validation.

posts.title: The Truth About AI Engineers (From an ex-CTO)
posts.excerpt: AI hasn't made learning easier for engineers—they just face different lessons now. The best engineers today use AI as a force multiplier, not a crutch.

arbor.title: How Arbor Works
arbor.subtitle: A smarter path to PAES mastery — personalized, adaptive, and AI-powered.

steps.label: Diagnostic
steps.description: Students take a diagnostic test that maps their strengths and gaps across every skill in the subject.

steps.label: Personalized Path
steps.description: Arbor builds a custom learning path based on each student's unique weaknesses using a granular skill tree.

steps.label: Adaptive Practice
steps.description: Micro-lessons (10–20 min) with worked examples and immediate practice, adjusting difficulty in real time.

steps.label: Mastery
steps.description: Spaced repetition and interleaving ensure long-term retention. Students advance only when they truly understand.
